input.title: Use export date in local time zone for export file names
input.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Change formatExportFilename to accept an optional date argument explicitly passed when exporting. The export route in src/api/reports.ts already could pass a date but was always passing new Date() which is local time now. We should ensure the date passed to formatExportFilename is in the user's local time zone to prevent the filename date shifting to the next day prematurely (e.g., for evening exports in some time zones).

label: bug
file: src/exportUtils.ts

The bug is caused by the export filename using a new Date() call that defaults to the server timezone UTC and does not reflect the reporter's local timezone. The responsible file is src/exportUtils.ts where formatExportFilename function formats the date part of the filename. The export API in src/api/reports.ts calls this passing a new Date() with no timezone adjustment. This PR will fix this to use the exporter's local timezone date.

label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

The export file names currently use slugify to convert report names to ASCII lowercase, dropping accents and replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, which removes Greek and Cyrillic characters. This PR proposes to preserve the original letters for non-Latin scripts to support meaningful export filenames for users with reports named in those scripts.
